Players Committee card image of [[Chewie With Bowcaster (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “Deploys -1 to Falcon. While 'hit,' draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Permanent weapon is •Chewbacca's Bowcaster (may target a character or vehicle for free; draw two destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value).”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/chewiewithbowcaster.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26 e8445f0] (1 June 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
